channel.title: Nature Methods
channel.description: Nature Methods offers a unique interdisciplinary forum for the publication of novel methods. Nature Methods focuses on the life sciences, combining practical, technique-driven subject matter with rigorous peer-review standards to ensure that readers are consistently presented with only the most valuable and highest quality methodological research. The journal offers its readers primary research papers as well as an array of opinions, reviews and short journalistic pieces to provide busy researchers with a broad, yet easily absorbed perspective of important methodological developments in the life sciences.

item.title: Next-generation multicolor indicators for in vivo imaging of norepinephrine
item.content:encoded:
Nature Methods, Published online: 26 February 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03006-z

Improved red and green indicators for norepinephrine and their characterization are reported. These indicators allow detection of norepinephrine release in awake behaving mice in dual-color fiber photometry and two-photon imaging applications.
item.dc:title: Next-generation multicolor indicators for in vivo imaging of norepinephrine

item.title: Using AI responsibly in scientific publishing
item.content:encoded:
Nature Methods, Published online: 11 February 2026; doi:10.1038/s41592-026-03020-1

Generative AI technology is having substantial impacts across society, and scientific publishing is by no means immune. We highlight journal policies around the use of generative AI and discuss its responsible use in writing, peer reviewing and publishing scientific research.
item.dc:title: Using AI responsibly in scientific publishing
